title: •Frustration
caption: •Frustration (V)
game_text:
USED: If you just peeked at cards in your Life Force, peek at and reorder the top 3 cards of that deck or pile (may take one into hand).
LOST: If Xizor and Guri are in a battle together, your total battle destiny is +5 and may retrieve 1 Force.

notes: Unique. Banner USED OR LOST INTERRUPT (printed base is a Lost Interrupt). USED:/LOST: lines separated by \n. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. Base page 'Frustration' is the printed archive face (same as 'Frustration (Original)'; errata at 'Frustration (PC Errata)'). The 745 px Dagobah-D-frustration.gif is tagged D-E1 (PC errata face: bottom text is the errata wording) — its top half (title, destiny 3, lore, art, copyright) matches the printed card, so it is used as art src for art only; the 350 px square-on decipher-archive scan of the printed face is also downloaded (src/vs7/15-Dagobah-D-frustration-decipher-archive.gif). Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes “Rrraaaarrr!” (wiki straight single). Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4 -pre, 350 px).
